remarks: A well-maintained 2 bedroom/1.5 bath townhome offering 1,188 sq ft of living space in a prime Norwalk location. The home features modern finishes throughout and smart home upgrades including smart light switches, Google smart thermostat, and LED bathroom mirrors with defoggers.  Lower Level: A 2-car garage with a NEMA 14-50 outlet available for EV charging and MyQ garage door opener. Main Level: A large, open living room that can accommodate a dining area, a fully equipped kitchen with stainless steel appliances, and a half bathroom featuring a heated bidet toilet seat. Upper Level: Two spacious bedrooms, including one with a walk-in closet. A full bathroom. In-unit Samsung washer and dryer add extra convenience.  Located just off Norwalk's Connecticut Avenue, this home offers easy access to shops, dining, and everyday essentials. Commuters will appreciate being minutes from I-95.
